scope: Shared package failure classification; applies to capture and signal installation, without new router commands or platform branches.
cause: Exact downloader request denial was misclassified as local account permissions and stopped PC fallback.
fix: Remove only an exact standalone downloader denied-request line from permission classification. Remaining permission/write/lock/signature/ABI errors still take priority. Emit a distinct retryable request-denied reason.
compatibility: Text classification is shared across supported OpenWrt versions and hardware. Only the exact observed downloader wording is reclassified; unknown forms retain prior behavior. No broad firmware or hardware certification claimed.
limits: Does not repair router networking itself or guarantee PC connectivity.
No signature bypass or existing package replacement introduced.
Current running application must reload source to use this change.

followup_review.finding: No new production defect found in the scoped change.
new_tests: Downloader request refusal on stderr reaches PC download in both production entrypoints
Fatal signature, permission, filesystem and lock errors in the other output stream block PC fallback in either stream order
followup_review.limits: Customer AC2100 and Debian desktop runtime are not revalidated; tests use production service methods with controlled command results.
